event_summary: A moving tan rod reaches a row of upright colored bars, after which the bars tilt and fall leftward in sequence.
raw_event_description: The scene opens with six upright colored rectangular bars arranged in a row on a wooden tabletop, with a black circular cylinder to their right and a tan pointed rod extending from the cylinder. The rod changes angular position while the bars remain upright. The rod reaches the right side of the purple bar at the end of the row. The purple bar tilts left, followed by the blue, green, pink, orange, and yellow bars changing orientation leftward one after another. By the end, the colored bars lie slanted or horizontal and partly overlapping on the tabletop, while the black cylinder remains in the same visible position and the rod remains protruding from it.

reasons: The upright colored bars, black cylinder, tan rod, tabletop, and background are visible before the bars begin moving.
